title: A Safety Case Per Robot Type: Starting Hazards for a Ground Vehicle, an Arm and a Legged Robot, and a Checker That Refuses a Case With a Hole in It

artifact.note: a safety case as data (hazards with severity, exposure and avoidability; controls with a kind, the safety primitive that implements them and the test that proves it; a residual level and a sign-off), starting hazards for a ground vehicle, an arm and a legged robot, a checker that lists every hole, and a markdown report
